nodes.name: Hot pressing DSC electrodes
nodes.procedure: Generally, a powder mixture consisting of 12 g supporting material/catalyst and 4 g Na₂CO₃ was prepressed with 0.32 t/cm² at ambient temperature, thereafter heated up to 400°C and hot-pressed with 0.8 t/cm². The thicknesses of the hot pressed cathodes vary from 2.1 to 4.3 mm and porosities of 42.1-80.2%. Specific examples: 7 g T255 carbonyl nickel + 5 g RaNi-50/50; 9.25 g T255 + 2.75 g preserved RaNi-50/50; 7 g T255 + 5 g alloyed RaNi catalyst.

nodes.name: Raney nickel leaching
nodes.procedure: The Al content was leached out in 6 N KOH at 80°C within 24 h to a residual content of about 3 wt%, consisting mostly of insoluble and corrosion resistant NiAl.
nodes.source_text: The Al content was leached out in 6 N KOH at 80°C within 24 h

nodes.name: Preserved Raney nickel preparation
nodes.procedure: The preserved Raney nickel catalyst were leached out in 6 N KOH at 80°C. The remainder was washed out, dried in vacuo at 22°C, and subsequently oxidized by controlled admission of atmospheric air in such a way that its temperature did not exceed 60°C. About 20-25 wt% of the nickel sponge was oxidized to a microcrystalline mixture of NiO-Ni(OH)₂, which was stabilized and transferred by subsequent heat treatment or hot pressing of the electrode at 200-400°C into coarser NiO crystallites.
